findings_addressed.oracle: Pre-seed ProviderName.OLLAMA via store.set() with a uuid-tagged api_key; list_providers() must return a non-empty list containing exactly one StoredCredential whose provider field equals ProviderName.OLLAMA. The seeded api_key is the independent oracle - it is the only reason that provider appears in the listing.
findings_addressed.documented_mutation: In src/intellicrack/credentials/store.py list_providers(), change `results.append(...)` inside the `if creds is not None and creds.api_key:` branch to `pass` (or return an empty list early) — the seeded provider would no longer appear in the result and the assertion `len(result) >= 1` would fail.

notes: G0124: Replaced the weak isinstance(result, list) assertion with a pre-seeded-credential gate. The test now calls store.set() with a UUID-tagged api_key for ProviderName.OLLAMA before calling list_providers(), then asserts the result contains exactly one StoredCredential matching that provider, with cleanup via store.delete() in the finally block. This simultaneously gates deadlock prevention (TimeoutError if deadlock) and actual list-building behavior (seeded entry must appear). The independent oracle is the seeded api_key value - without it, list_providers has no basis to include OLLAMA in results.
